title: Bifurcations
description: Turn a setting slowly and, at one value, a steady state turns unstable and the system starts to oscillate: the Belousov reaction's threshold, and a heartbeat's.

puzzle.goal: In the Brusselator with feeds A and B the steady state turns unstable, and the mixture oscillates, past one value of B. Write that value H.
puzzle.name: Hopf threshold
puzzle.method: Linearise round the steady state (A, B/A): its trace B − 1 − A² changes sign there, and a pair of eigenvalues crosses the imaginary axis.
